newsitem.title: USA: AM Q2 oper results aided by restructuring.
newsitem.headline: AM Q2 oper results aided by restructuring.

text.p: AM International Inc said its operating results from continuing operations for the February 1 second quarter improved over a year ago due to restructurings it implemented.
Such moves resulted in improved gross margin rates and lower selling, general and administrative expense levels, it said.
The restructuring actions included head-count reductions and other cost-reduction measures, including divestitures of unprofitable foreign operations.
AM reported a net loss of $850,000 compared to a year-ago loss of $8.7 million, which included a loss of $4.4 million from discontinued operations.

Revenues for the quarter were $20.8 million, or $20.1 million below the prior-year comparative quarter, with $17 million of the decrease attributable to the divested foreign subsidiaries in Japan and Canada and the exit from the sale of discontinued manufactured machines.
AM's continuing operations consist solely of the AM Multigraphics domestic distribution and service business.
